items.name: antimicrobial-peptide-prediction
items.description: Benchmarking protein language models (ProtBERT, ESM-2, ProtT5) against a k-mer baseline for binary antimicrobial peptide classification

items.name: Antimicrobial-Peptides-Graph-Generation-via-ESM2-and-GVAE
items.description: This project constructs protein structural graphs from AMP sequences using ESM2 embeddings and spatial structure information, then trains a Graph Variational Autoencoder (GVAE) for graph-level representation learning.

items.name: NLP-with-Antimicrobials
items.description: Exploring numerous natural language processing techniques for antimicrobial peptide sequences.

items.name: amp-discovery
items.description: Antimicrobial peptide discovery via ESM-2 fine-tuning. LoRA training on ESCAPE/GenPept-Curated-2025/PepBenchmark with multilabel evaluation.

items.name: Machine-Learning-Based-Classification-of-Antimicrobial-Peptides-and-Toxicity-Prediction
items.description: Comparative ML study for classifying antimicrobial peptides (antibacterial, antifungal, antiviral) using ESM-2 embeddings. Models include SVM, KNN, RF, and XGBoost with SMOTE for imbalance. XGBoost achieved ~88% accuracy, with SHAP for interpretability.

items.name: transformer_model_pipelines
items.description: Pipelines for ESM-2 and BERT in antimicrobial peptide (AMP) prediction that I use for conducting research :D
